children.value:
tena bandhumaraṇena durbhikṣeṇa ca sadbāṣpaṃ sabāṣpaṃ ācāntayeva sravantyā
īkṣaṇadhārayā astradhārayā

sa tādṛśaḥ praśno mayā yathāvastu vastuyāthārthyaṃ tadbhāvena uktaḥ
samāhitaḥ

bhramodāra ivaiṣo'rtha iti pāṭhe na me
galatītyetaduttaraṃ saṃśayapadamadhyāhāryam

tathāca kalpitatvāviśeṣe'pi saṃvādavisaṃvādābhyāmeva loke
satyatvamithyātvavyavahāro na paramārthavimarśenetyāśayenāha -
kākatālīyavaditi
tarhi lavaṇavyavahāre kayā rītyā saṃvādastamāha - vṛttamiti

pakkaṇe
prākkasyacidyadvṛttaṃ cāṇḍālīvivāhādi tallavaṇasya manogataṃ pratibhātamiti
saṃvādabhrama ityarthaḥ

yadyapi lavaṇasya bhrāntāvanubhava eva na
smṛtistathāpyanubhavasmṛtyādyavāntaravailakṣaṇyamapi kalpanāmātratvānna
vimarśakṣamamiti sūcanāyetthamuktam

pratibhāsasaṃvādayoḥ pūrvāparabhāvo'pi kalpanāmātratvānna vyavasthita
ityāśayenāha - vindhyeti dvābhyām

pratibhābhedakalpanamapi tathā ekatra jātāyā evobhayatra
bhānasaṃbhavādityāśayenāha - lāvaṇīti

bahūnāṃ kavīnāṃ
mānasotprekṣāracitakāvyārthapratipādakaṃ vacanaṃ kadācitsadṛśaṃ
sacchabdato'rthataśca saṃvāda bhavati tathā lavaṇapulkasabhrāntirūpe svapne'pi
bhavatītyarthaḥ
tarhi kiṃ sā vyavahāragatiratyantāsatī netyāha - vyavahāreti

saṃvedanasattaiva bhūtabhavyabhaviṣyatprapañcagatā satī
saṃvedanāditareva bhāti jale vīciriva bīje taruriva cetyarthaḥ

pārthivatvadravatvābhyāṃ samāsamayogataḥ yo jatukāṣṭhādisaṃbandhaḥ asau
asadṛśayoranyonyayoḥ saṃbandhodāharaṇāya na yogyo yatastadubhayatastasyā
avidyāyā ekasyā eva spando vilāsastanmātramityarthaḥ

yadi tu cinmayamevābhyupagamyeta tarhi samaistaiścitaḥ saṃbandha upapadyata
ityāha - parārthamayamiti

yathā yena prakāreṇa paramārthamayāstena hetunā
citā samā iti saṃbandhavaśataścetyante citā prakāśyante iti bhavedityarthaḥ

tadā svānubhavasthiteḥ
svaprakāśatābalādeva vibhānti na cidantarasaṃbandhabalāt
uktameva kalpadvayaṃ ślokadvayena sphuṭaṃ punarāha - na saṃbhavatīti

yo mūḍhānāṃ cetanasya ciccetyacititārūpeṇa dṛśyayā tripuṭyā
uditatvānubhavaḥ sa na cijjaḍayorabhedasaṃbandhamādāyopapādayituṃ śakya
ityāśayenāha - ciditi

nāpi cinmayānāṃ citā saṃbandha iti
pakṣamādāyāpyupapādayituṃ śakyata ityāha - cinmayatvāditi

nanu jaḍatvena sāmye'pi yathā dārupāṣāṇamṛdāmekagṛhaghaṭakatvena yogo
yathā vā.pyatvena sājātye'pi jihvārasayoryogastathā cittvena sāmye'pi dṛśo
dṛśyayogo'stu tatrāha - dārviti

dārvādijaḍapadārtho
gṛhādipadārthabhāvena pariṇāmī anubhūyate natu cidityarthaḥ

sajātīyābhyāṃ jihvārasābhyāmamalaḥ sphuṭa udayo yasya tathāvidho rasāsvādo
rāsanacittavṛttirūpaḥ pariṇāmyanubhūyate ityanuṣaṅgaḥ

kiṃcidabhinnayorekībhāvo hi saṃbandhaḥ sa ca pakṣadvaye'pi durghaṭa ityāha -
aikyaṃ ceti

tarhi paramārthacidātmanāṃ kāṣṭhapāṣāṇādīnāṃ kathaṃ gṛhabhāvena
saṃbandho dṛśyate tatrāha - tadātmaneti

kalpitarūpeṇaiva teṣāṃ
saṃbandho dṛśyate na vāstavacidrūpeṇetyarthaḥ

yadyasmāddhetoranantaṃ
brahmaiva sarvaprakārāḍhyaṃ sarvamiva bhāti tato hetorviśvaṃ sanmātramiti
pareṇānvayaḥ

yatastat hemadeśādeva deśaṃ
hemabhavanādeva bhavaṃ sattaṃ ca labhate iti śeṣaḥ

kaṭakādimahābhedaṃ hema yathā bhedadṛgdarśanaparityāge ekaṃ hemaiva
tadvadityarthaḥ

kumbhādyanusyūtaṃ niṣkṛṣṭamṛtsvarūpamiva draṣṭrāditripuṭyanusyūtaṃ
tatsākṣicinmātraṃ tripuṭīnirāsena darśayati - saṃbandhe iti

tatprāgdarśitaṃ
yatparaṃ brahma tadidaṃ niṣkṛṣṭapratyaksvarūpamevetyakhaṇḍo vākyārtho
darśito draṣṭavyaḥ
nanu kṣubdhasya kathaṃ tanmayatā tiṣṭhettatrāha - kasyaciditi

yathā anāgate vyavahārye cittasyānāsaṅgaḥ svataḥsiddhastathā vartamāne'pi
mithyātvadṛṣṭyā saṃpādanīya ityāśayenāha - bhaviṣyaditi

yadyasmādātmanā ātmasvarūpeṇa vivicya darśane acittataiva
viduṣāmanubhavasiddhetyarthaḥ

tasmānna
jananamiyānnāntamiyānnetpāpmānaṃ mṛtyumanvavāyāni iti śrutyā
mlecchānuvṛtterniṣiddhatvāditi bhāvaḥ

bhūtaṃ mṛtameva sat adya vetti mithyā paśyatīti
gauṇaḥ kalpaḥ

mahānubhāvastattvāvabodhakuśalaḥ san prathamaṃ vyapagalitamanā bhava
tatastattvabodhenāmalātmā san bhavapāragato bhava

uktārthaṃ draḍhayituṃ
vasiṣṭho vicāraviśuddhaṃ svānubhavamāha - suciramiti

mayā suciramapi
manastattvalābhāya vicāritaṃ tathāpyamalātmani mānasātmakaṃ malaṃ kiṃcidapi
na labdhaṃ tasmānnāstyeveti madvākyādapi sthiro bhavetyarthaḥ
